text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high primarily because a small number of drink products dominate sales (product concentration), not broad-based drink demand","priorConfidence":0.55,"target":"beverage_revenue_by_product","action":"breakdown","expectation":"A small subset (e.g. top 1-3) of products in beverage_revenue_by_product account for a disproportionate share (>50%) of order_item.drink_revenue; if revenue is evenly spread across many products, this is refuted"},{"statement":"High beverage revenue is driven mainly by repeat/loyal customers rather than broad customer acquisition, i.e. a concentrated set of top beverage buyers","priorConfidence":0.5,"target":"top_beverage_customers","action":"lookup_block","expectation":"top_beverage_customers shows a small number of customers contributing a large share of drink_revenue with high customer_profile lifetime order counts; if revenue is spread evenly across many low-frequency customers, this is refuted"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high because one customer_type (e.g. a specific segment) purchases drinks disproportionately more than others","priorConfidence":0.5,"target":"customers.customer_type","action":"breakdown","expectation":"order_item.drink_revenue broken down by customers.customer_type shows one segment contributing a majority share; if drink_revenue_pct is roughly similar across customer_type segments, this is refuted"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue's high share is a recent phenomenon driven by accelerating month-over-month growth in drink sales rather than a stable historical pattern","priorConfidence":0.4,"target":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom","action":"compare_time","expectation":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom for drink items shows consistently positive/accelerating growth in recent months; if growth is flat or declining, this is refuted"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high relative to food not because of higher order volume but because average drink order value/price is higher, reflected in order_item.drink_revenue_pct outpacing order counts","priorConfidence":0.45,"target":"order_item.drink_revenue_pct","action":"lookup_metric","expectation":"order_item.drink_revenue_pct is substantially higher than the share of orders.drink_orders relative to orders.orders, indicating price/mix rather than volume drives the revenue share; if the two shares are proportional, this is refuted"},{"statement":"Overall monthly revenue growth (monthly_revenue) is being driven predominantly by beverage revenue rather than food revenue, making beverages the main growth engine rather than just a large static share","priorConfidence":0.5,"target":"monthly_revenue","action":"compare_time","expectation":"In monthly_revenue trends, month-over-month increases correlate closely with increases in order_item.drink_revenue while order_item.food_revenue stays flat; if food_revenue growth tracks or exceeds drink_revenue growth, this is refuted"}]}
